name: exec
arguments:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat /private/tmp/byko-purpose-review-20261019.kuA3QA/baseline/shared/task-contract.md && nl -ba /private/tmp/byko-purpose-review-20261019.kuA3QA/fixtures/code/review-baseline.md && python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
base = Path('/private/tmp/byko-purpose-review-20261019.kuA3QA/fixtures/code')
cases = [
    ('ordinary', 'a', 3, 7),
    ('exact', 'a', 10, 0),
    ('insufficient', 'a', 11, ValueError),
    ('zero', 'a', 0, ValueError),
    ('negative', 'a', -1, ValueError),
    ('bool_true', 'a', True, ValueError),
    ('bool_false', 'a', False, ValueError),
    ('float', 'a', 1.0, ValueError),
    ('str', 'a', '1', ValueError),
    ('none', 'a', None, ValueError),
    ('missing', 'missing', 1, KeyError),
    ('empty_sku', 'empty', 1, ValueError),
]
for name in ('candidate_a.py', 'candidate_b.py'):
    p = base / name
    source = p.read_bytes()
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), namespace)
    fn = namespace['deduct']
    print(name, 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest())
    failures = 0
    for title, sku, quantity, expected in cases:
        stock = {'a': 10, 'b': 20, 'empty': 0}
        before = stock.copy()
        try:
            actual = fn(stock, sku, quantity)
        except Exception as exc:
            actual = type(exc)
        expected_state = before.copy()
        if not isinstance(expected, type):
            expected_state[sku] = expected
        ok = actual == expected and stock == expected_state
        failures += not ok
        print(title, 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', 'actual=', getattr(actual, '__name__', actual), 'stock=', stock)
    stock = {'a': 10, 'b': 20}
    results = [fn(stock, 'a', 3), fn(stock, 'b', 4), fn(stock, 'a', 7)]
    ok = results == [7, 16, 0] and stock == {'a': 0, 'b': 16}
    failures += not ok
    print('multi_sku_sequence', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', results, stock)
    print('total', len(cases) + 1, 'failures', failures)
PY","max_output_tokens":9000}));
